name: cli-for-agent
description: Patterns for designing CLIs that coding agents can run reliably: non-interactive flags, layered help with examples, pipelines, actionable errors, idempotency, and dry-run.

interface.shortDescription: Design CLIs agents can run reliably
interface.longDescription: Patterns for non-interactive command-line tools: layered help with copy-pasteable examples, stdin and pipelines, actionable errors, idempotency, dry-run, and predictable command structure.
interface.defaultPrompt: Design or review this CLI so coding agents can run it reliably without interactive surprises.
